verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents per-customer monitoring through endpoints to monitor or unmonitor a customer, set its monitoring configuration and read its monitor status. Risk alerts raised during ongoing monitoring flow into case management, where they can be prioritised, decided and remediated in the web app or via the API. Webhooks exist for screening workflows, and there is an export type for screening and monitoring cases. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that re-screening is triggered by watchlist/list updates, a documented monitoring-specific webhook event type for changed results (only WORKFLOW_COMPLETED is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
